user.title: Set up Passable Smart Screen Time Engine
user.description: Configure the smart TVs, media players, and personal devices you want to manage with automated downtime schedules and "One More Show" viewing timers.

data.import_helpers: Import Existing Schedules from Legacy Helpers

data_description.devices: Select Smart TVs / Media Players (media_player) or network pause switches (switch, e.g. Eero Wi-Fi pause for tablets) to manage.
data_description.global_restrictions: Select any input boolean or group entities (e.g. Dog Needs Out, Homework Time) that should immediately restrict all devices when active.
data_description.import_helpers: Automatically import existing TV & tablet schedules and toggles from legacy input_text and input_boolean helpers into .storage.

error.no_devices_selected: Please select at least one media player or switch to manage.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Passable Smart Screen Time Engine is supported.

init.title: Passable Smart Screen Time Engine Settings
init.description: Add or remove managed devices, update global restrictions, or trigger a schedule re-import.

data_description.devices: Select Smart TVs / Media Players (media_player) or network pause switches (switch).
data_description.global_restrictions: Entities that trigger an immediate lockout across all devices when ON.
data_description.import_helpers: Re-scan Home Assistant for legacy helpers and merge any new schedules into storage.

start_timer.name: Start Viewing Timer
start_timer.description: Starts a temporary countdown viewing timer ("One More Show") and unlocks the target device.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: The ID of the managed device (e.g., living_room_tv_2).

cancel_timer.name: Cancel Viewing Timer
cancel_timer.description: Cancels an active countdown timer for a device.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: The ID of the managed device.

set_lockout.name: Set Device Lockout
set_lockout.description: Explicitly lock or unlock a device and update hardware power or network pause.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: The ID of the managed device, or 'all' to set all devices.

locked.name: Locked
locked.description: True to lock (restrict), False to unlock.

power_on.name: Power On Device
power_on.description: If unlocking, whether to also turn ON the media player or unpause network switch.

toggle_all_lockouts.name: Toggle All Lockouts
toggle_all_lockouts.description: Master toggle for all managed devices. Unlocks all devices if any are locked; locks all devices if all are unlocked.

import_legacy_helpers.name: Import Legacy Helpers
import_legacy_helpers.description: Scans Home Assistant for legacy device_lockout helpers (input_text and input_boolean) and imports schedules into storage.
